coordination)."><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="arrow" d="M0,0L10,5L0,10z"/></marker><marker text-anchor="middle">Several agents: three things they can buy, three things they always cost</text><text class="t-note" x="200.0" y="54.0" text-anchor="middle">what you can gain</text><text class="t-note" x="560.0" y="54.0" text-anchor="middle">what you pay</text><rect class="box-3" x="40.0" y="68.0" width="320.0" height="62.0" rx="10"/><text class="t-note" x="200.0" y="90.0" text-anchor="middle">the lead keeps a short context</text><rect class="box-3" x="40.0" y="142.0" width="320.0" height="62.0" rx="10"/><text class="t-note" x="200.0" y="164.0" text-anchor="middle">parallel breadth</text><text class="t-tick" x="200.0" y="182.0" text-anchor="middle">independent parts run at once;</text><text class="t-tick" x="200.0" y="199.0" text-anchor="middle">time = the slowest part</text><rect class="box-3" x="40.0" y="216.0" width="320.0" height="62.0" rx="10"/><text class="t-note" x="200.0" y="238.0" text-anchor="middle">specialisation</text><text class="t-tick" x="200.0" y="256.0" text-anchor="middle">own prompt, own tools, own</text><text class="t-tick" x="200.0" y="273.0" text-anchor="middle">model per role</text><rect class="box-1" x="400.0" y="68.0" width="320.0" height="62.0" rx="10"/><text class="t-note" x="560.0" y="90.0" text-anchor="middle">tokens</text><text class="t-tick" x="560.0" y="108.0" text-anchor="middle">every agent pays its own prompt,</text><text class="t-tick" x="560.0" y="125.0" text-anchor="middle">brief, reading and report</text><rect class="box-1" x="400.0" y="142.0" width="320.0" height="62.0" rx="10"/><text class="t-note" x="560.0" y="164.0" text-anchor="middle">latency</text><text class="t-tick" x="560.0" y="182.0" text-anchor="middle">planning, waiting for the</text><text class="t-tick" x="560.0" y="199.0" text-anchor="middle">slowest, then merging</text><rect class="box-1" x="400.0" y="216.0" width="320.0" height="62.0" rx="10"/><text class="t-note" x="560.0" y="238.0" text-anchor="middle">coordination</text><text class="t-tick" x="560.0" y="256.0" text-anchor="middle">what the brief leaves out is lost;</text><text class="t-tick" x="560.0" y="273.0" text-anchor="middle">parallel choices can conflict</text><text class="t-muted" x="20.0" y="310.0" text-anchor="start">A multi-agent design is worth it only when the left column is large for your task: the work is</text><text class="t-muted" x="20.0" y="327.0" text-anchor="start">broad, splits into parts that do not depend on each other, and is too much for one context. The</text><text class="t-muted" x="20.0" y="344.0" text-anchor="start">right column is paid on every task.</text></svg>
